A '''corvette''' served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. While being chased by a [[Unidentified Imperial-class Star Destroyer (Rebel Alliance corvette)|Star Destroyer]], both [[Starship/Legends|ships]] were captured by an [[Extragalactic/Legends|extra-galactic]] [[Unidentified googly-eyed species|species]]. The crews of both vessels were pitted against each other in a series of contests that the Alliance won.<ref name="Night" />
